description: Defines the QTensorImpl class, a specialized TensorImpl for quantized tensors in PyTorch, including methods for managing quantizers and shallow copying.

classes.name: QTensorImpl
classes.description: A TensorImpl for quantized tensors, storing quantization scheme and parameters, with methods for shallow copying and managing quantizers.

methods.name: quantizer
methods.description: Returns the quantizer associated with this tensor implementation.

methods.name: set_quantizer_
methods.description: Sets the quantizer for this tensor implementation.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of this tensor implementation, detaching it from the current computational graph.

methods.name: shallow_copy_from
methods.description: Copies tensor metadata from another TensorImpl into this one.
